claim_a_text: HOG features with a linear SVM are highly effective for human detection, outperforming other feature sets including wavelets and PCA-SIFT.
claim_b_text: CNN-based features (R-CNN) dramatically outperform HOG-like features for object detection, achieving a large improvement in mAP on PASCAL VOC.
claim_a_quote: grids of Histograms of Oriented Gradient (HOG) descriptors significantly outperform existing feature sets for human detection.
claim_b_quote: a CNN can lead to dramatically higher object detection performance on PASCAL VOC as compared to systems based on simpler HOG-like features.
rationale: Article A (2005) champions HOG as state-of-the-art for detection, while Article B (2014) shows CNNs supersede HOG, marking a shift from handcrafted to learned features.
